result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly with no significant visual defects. Layout, spacing, and typography are consistent across the header, promo banner, carousels, and restaurant cards. Only a couple of minor cosmetic observations were found.

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top-right corner appears as an empty gray circle with a red notification dot, suggesting the avatar image or initials failed to load or was never set.
issues.suggestion: Show a fallback such as the user's initials or a generic person icon inside the avatar circle instead of leaving it blank.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the delivery fee lines (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') sit at slightly different vertical positions relative to the restaurant names because titles can wrap or vary in length, making the row baseline look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Fix the card title to a consistent height (e.g., single line with ellipsis) so the delivery fee row aligns across all cards.
